title: Enable HiDPI scaling in Xfce
summary: Enable window scaling and select an XHDPI theme in Xfce to make the interface usable on high-resolution displays.

steps.explain: Open the Appearance settings and set the Window Scaling factor to 2.
steps.gui: Settings Manager > Appearance > Settings > Window Scaling > 2

steps.explain: Open the Window Manager settings and select the Default-xhdpi theme.
steps.gui: Settings Manager > Window Manager > Style > Default-xhdpi

steps.explain: Alternatively, use xfconf-query to set the scaling factor to 2.
Alternatively, use xfconf-query to set the window manager theme.
